description: This file contains functions related to authentication API interactions such as registering users, login, token refresh, and logout, including token extraction and normalization utilities.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from the backend authentication response, handling multiple response formats.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token string by removing 'Bearer' prefix and null/undefined strings.

methods.name: safeSetTokens
methods.description: Stores tokens securely if they are valid, avoiding invalid strings.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Function to register a new applicant user via POST request.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login, clears old tokens, stores new tokens, and returns response data.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes the auth tokens using the refresh token, updating stored tokens accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the backend.
